    • adminRealmsGet

      @RequestMapping(method=GET, value="/admin/realms", produces="application/json") @ResponseStatus(OK) reactor.core.publisher.Flux<org.bremersee.keycloak.api.model.RealmRepresentation> adminRealmsGet(@Valid @RequestParam(value="briefRepresentation",required=false,defaultValue="false") @Valid Boolean briefRepresentation)
      GET /admin/realms : Get accessible realms Returns a list of accessible realms. The list is filtered based on what realms the caller is allowed to view.
      Parameters:
      briefRepresentation - (optional, default to false)
      Returns:
      OK (status code 200) or Forbidden (status code 403)

      @RequestMapping(method=GET, value="/admin/realms/{realm}/users/count", produces="application/json") @ResponseStatus(OK) reactor.core.publisher.Mono<Integer> adminRealmsRealmUsersCountGet(@PathVariable("realm") String realm, @Valid @RequestParam(value="createdAfter",required=false) @Nullable @Valid String createdAfter, @Valid @RequestParam(value="createdBefore",required=false) @Nullable @Valid String createdBefore, @Valid @RequestParam(value="email",required=false) @Nullable @Valid String email, @Valid @RequestParam(value="emailVerified",required=false) @Nullable @Valid Boolean emailVerified, @Valid @RequestParam(value="enabled",required=false) @Nullable @Valid Boolean enabled, @Valid @RequestParam(value="exact",required=false) @Nullable @Valid Boolean exact, @Valid @RequestParam(value="firstName",required=false) @Nullable @Valid String firstName, @Valid @RequestParam(value="idpAlias",required=false) @Nullable @Valid String idpAlias, @Valid @RequestParam(value="idpUserId",required=false) @Nullable @Valid String idpUserId, @Valid @RequestParam(value="lastName",required=false) @Nullable @Valid String lastName, @Valid @RequestParam(value="q",required=false) @Nullable @Valid String q, @Valid @RequestParam(value="search",required=false) @Nullable @Valid String search, @Valid @RequestParam(value="username",required=false) @Nullable @Valid String username)
      GET /admin/realms/{realm}/users/count : Returns the number of users that match the given criteria. It can be called in three different ways. 1. Donâ€™t specify any criteria and pass null. The number of all users within that realm will be returned. <p> 2. If search is specified other criteria such as last will be ignored even though you set them. The search string will be matched against the first and last name, the username and the email of a user. <p> 3. If search is unspecified but any of last, first, email or username those criteria are matched against their respective fields on a user entity. Combined with a logical and.
      Parameters:
      realm - realm name (not id!) (required)
      createdAfter - Only return users created after (inclusive) the given date, in ISO-8601 format (yyyy-MM-dd) or epoch milliseconds (optional)
      createdBefore - Only return users created before (inclusive) the given date, in ISO-8601 format (yyyy-MM-dd) or epoch milliseconds (optional)
      email - A String contained in email, or the complete email, if param \"exact\" is true (optional)
      emailVerified - whether the email has been verified (optional)
      enabled - Boolean representing if user is enabled or not (optional)
      exact - Boolean which defines whether the params \"last\", \"first\", \"email\" and \"username\" must match exactly (optional)
      firstName - A String contained in firstName, or the complete firstName, if param \"exact\" is true (optional)
      idpAlias - The alias of an Identity Provider linked to the user (optional)
      idpUserId - The userId at an Identity Provider linked to the user (optional)
      lastName - A String contained in lastName, or the complete lastName, if param \"exact\" is true (optional)
      q - A query to search for custom attributes, in the format 'key1:value2 key2:value2' (optional)
      search - A String contained in username, first or last name, or email. Default search behavior is prefix-based (e.g., foo or foo*). Use *foo* for infix search and \"foo\" for exact search. (optional)
      username - A String contained in username, or the complete username, if param \"exact\" is true (optional)
      Returns:
      OK (status code 200) or Forbidden (status code 403)
